row.evidence: Bigtincan's SAML guide says "Bigtincan is a Just-in-Time (JIT) Provisioning platform" (accounts created on first SSO sign-in), and its help centre has no SCIM article; pricing is "Connect with our sales team" only.
row.notes: New row. No SCIM endpoint documented: user automation is SAML JIT on sign-in, LDAP/Active Directory sync via the AD Bridge, CSV bulk upload, and the Bigtincan Hub public REST API (create, update, delete users and manage groups, OAuth 2.0 / API key). JIT-only, so none per the rules (user may reclassify). Okta's OIN app is SAML-only. All editions (Essential, Elite, plus Readiness/Content/Engagement starter packages) are quote-only. Bigtincan also sells acquired products (Brainshark, Zunos, StorySlab, ClearSlide) with their own user admin; Brainshark's Entra SAML also creates users on login and maps groups to roles.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: SSO plan listing comes from the Brainshark-on-Bigtincan Entra SSO article; Hub SAML docs name no plan.

scim.notes: Not offered by absence: the help centre has no SCIM article (search count 0) and describes Bigtincan as a SAML JIT provisioning platform; the public API has no SCIM resource.

endpoints.purpose: Remove a user from a group

okta.notes: OIN page (last updated Aug 2015) has only SAML checked in its markup; no SCIM or provisioning.

entra.notes: No Bigtincan tutorial in Microsoft's Entra SaaS tutorial index; Bigtincan documents Entra/Azure AD as a custom SAML app (help articles).

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP / Active Directory sync (on-premise AD Bridge, manage users via AD groups) configured under Platform Configuration > Security > Authentication
